remarks: Located at 1618 State Route 417 in the Town of Bolivar, this furnished 2-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home is situated on two adjoining parcels totaling 26.6 acres. Perched on a hillside overlooking State Route 417 and the Village of Bolivar, the property is well suited for use as a primary residence, seasonal getaway, or turnkey hunting retreat. Built in 1992, the one-story home offers approximately 1,426 square feet of living space with private water and septic, natural-gas forced-air heat, and a supplemental natural-gas heating stove. Set more than 225 feet back from the road, the home enjoys a private setting with mature tree canopy providing additional screening. Most furnishings are included in the sale, subject to the seller’s exclusion list. The seller-built 18 x 12 detached garage is insulated and equipped with electric, heat, a metal roof, and a 7 x 8 overhead door. A separate 12 x 20 storage shed provides additional space for tools, ATVs, lawn equipment, and hunting gear. Electric service is also available for a camper or other recreational use. The acreage is mostly wooded with a mixed hardwood forest dominated by hard maple and red oak. The land rises approximately 288 feet from State Route 417 to the ridge at the rear of the property. The gently sloping terrain remains very walkable and includes an established trail system with ATV access throughout much of the acreage. Numerous well-traveled and matted-down deer runs provide clear evidence of wildlife activity. The seller has enjoyed many successful hunting seasons on the property, making this a proven recreational tract with the added convenience of a furnished year-round home. Both parcels offer approximately 1,335 feet of combined road frontage along State Route 417. An existing billboard lease is included in the sale and currently generates approximately $800 per year. Combined annual property taxes for both parcels are approximately $3,095. Conveniently located approximately 6 minutes from the PA state line, 17 minutes from Wellsville, 32 minutes from Olean, 45 minutes from Hornell, 1 hour 45 minutes from Buffalo & Rochester
